title.narrative: Implementation of sustainable strategic interventions to contain the HIV epidemic among key populations in Kazakhstan - Kazakhstan (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Kazakhstan, HIV, Kazakh scientific center of dermatology and infectious diseases of the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Kazakhstan (KSCDID)This program has the following goals: Sustainability and continuity of testing and prevention services for key populations, adherence of PLHIV to treatment.. The objectives of this program are: Improve access to and use of combination HIV prevention for people at increased risk of HIV, including the scale up of PrEP. Strengthen and scale up tailored to key populations HIV testing strategies and interventions that include community-based testing, HIV selftesting, as well as social network-based and safe ethical partner (index) testing;. Strengthen linkage to HIV care/treatment services and bolster treatment adherence support. Support further transition of funding for key populations HIV interventions to the domestic budgets
